class.name: AutorunInf
class.brief_description: Builds an [code]autorun.inf[/code] document for Windows disc and USB packaging.
class.description: Assembles the [code][autorun][/code] section used by [EditorExportDeviceAutorun]. USB flash drives on Windows 7 and later ignore [code]OPEN=[/code] and [code]ACTION=[/code]; this class does not change AutoRun policy.

method.name: build
method.description: Returns the [code]autorun.inf[/code] text, including optional [code]shell\verb[/code] command pairs.

method.name: usb_note_text
method.description: Returns the USB AutoPlay limitation note written as [code]START.txt[/code] when [code]autorun/write_usb_note[/code] is enabled.

members.member: Extra [code]shell\verb[/code] / [code]shell\verb\command[/code] pairs. Keys are verb names; values are commands.
